 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 “Daily Dose of Deep Hydration.”

Start your day with deep, lasting hydration. Studd Muffyn Hyaluronic Water Gel is powered by pure Hyaluronic Complex that pulls moisture deep into your skin and keeps it locked in all day. 

Its lightweight, water-gel texture melts instantly, giving your skin a fresh, non-sticky, morning glow. Perfect as your AM routine essential, it helps maintain smooth, plump, and balanced skin—even in humid weather.

Use it every morning after cleansing to hydrate, soothe, and prep your skin for sunscreen or makeup.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Can I use it every morning?

Yes! This gel is designed as an AM essential for daily hydration.

2. Is it suitable for oily or acne-prone skin?

Absolutely. It is lightweight, water-based, and non-comedogenic.

3. Can I layer it under makeup?

Yes, it acts as a smooth, hydrating base for foundation or sunscreen.

4. Do I need moisturiser after this?

If you have dry skin, you can top it with a richer cream. For normal–oily skin, this gel alone is enough.

5. Can men use it?

Yes — it is completely gender-neutral and suits all skin types.
